description: Source code for repository settings configuration in a Git-like system, including functions to prepare, clear, get, and set repository configuration parameters.

methods.name: repo_cfg_bool
methods.description: Helper function to get boolean repository config and assign default if needed.

methods.name: repo_cfg_int
methods.description: Helper function to get integer repository config and assign default if needed.

methods.name: repo_cfg_ulong
methods.description: Helper function to get unsigned long repository config and assign default if needed.

methods.name: prepare_repo_settings
methods.description: Initializes and configures repository settings based on repository configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: repo_settings_clear
methods.description: Resets repository settings to default/empty state.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold for big files in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold for big files in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_log_all_ref_updates
methods.description: Gets the configuration for logging all reference updates.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs
methods.description: Gets warning setting for ambiguous refs.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_hooks_path
methods.description: Retrieves the hooks path for the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_reset_shared_repository
methods.description: Resets the shared repository configuration to default.
